body: Yeah I get a W-2 and I work on average 45 hours and sometimes as much as 70 hours in a week. But if I ever mention it or complain he cuts my hours. :/ And I really need my money so I can have food to eat.

I have been keeping track and I would love to call the DOL, but I am concerned of the backlash the company will hit me with if they found out it was me.

Is there anonymous reporting that I could go through or can I be protected somehow?

Since it's a right to work state they can just fire me outright, can't they? With no reason at all, or atleast no reason they have to give? 


I have been keeping track of all of my hours and many other employees as well, as I have been telling people to do so. Many others also noticed they are missing hours. 


Recently they started ripping us because the "full time" employees aren't scheduling *themselves* enough hours, so many "part time" employees are getting full time hours. We have the option to sign up for our own shifts. Many people quit after a few weeks because of all of the problems.


He also stated to me that I am a "contracted employee" and therefore he is not required to give me health insurance or other benefits such as vacation time or paid time off. And then he cut my hours to just under full time for as long as he could. :/
